prior_art.basis: Independent review by claude-independent-prior-art-reviewer-20261106: No open or discoverable solution gives anyone a once-a-year senescent-cell clearance treatment, so the Main KPI of 1,000,000,000 people treated yearly is not met by existing work. No senolytic has regulatory approval (industry review, March 2026); dasatinib+quercetin and fisetin are investigational multi-day cycles in small trials (SEN-SURVIVORS NCT04733534) and Unity's UBX1325 is a local eye injection with mixed phase 2 results (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12910722). The nearest single-dose, long-acting results are preclinical: anti-uPAR senolytic CAR T cells persisting over 15 months after one infusion in mice (Amor et al., Nature Aging 2024, https://www.nature.com/articles/s43587-023-00560-5) and GPNMB senolytic vaccination in progeroid mice (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37117524/). Open source exists only upstream of therapy: senolytic screening code at https://github.com/felixjwong/senolyticsai. Partial leads, not the end goal; tasks that merely replicate them must carry their own prior-art basis.
